tool_calls.input:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/verify_repair_w35.py
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path("/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation")
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
+
+from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
+from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
+from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
+
+manifest = load_manifest(version="tome-1.7.6")
+loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))
+baseline = loader.load_path(
+    ROOT / ".ai/task/repair-w35-20260926/baseline/tome-cults.lua",
+    logical_path="tome-cults.lua",
+).translations
+current = loader.load_path(ROOT / "tome-cults.lua", logical_path="tome-cults.lua").translations
+workset = json.loads((ROOT / ".ai/task/repair-w35-20260926/WORKSET.json").read_text())
+
+if len(baseline) != len(current):
+    raise SystemExit(f"record count changed: {len(baseline)} -> {len(current)}")
+
+changed = []
+non_target = []
+ignored = {"target", "line", "logical_path"}
+for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(baseline, current)):
+    before_stable = {key: value for key, value in before.items() if key not in ignored}
+    after_stable = {key: value for key, value in after.items() if key not in ignored}
+    if before_stable != after_stable:
+        non_target.append(index)
+    if before["target"] != after["target"]:
+        changed.append((index, before, after))
+
+expected = {
+    (item["source"], item.get("source_tag"), item["target_preimage"])
+    for item in workset["items"]
+}
+actual = {(before["source"], before.get("source_tag"), before["target"]) for _, before, _ in changed}
+unexpected = actual - expected
+missing = expected - actual
+
+def line_shape(value):
+    lines = value.split("\n")
+    return (
+        len(lines),
+        tuple(index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line == ""),
+        tuple(len(line) - len(line.lstrip("\t")) for line in lines),
+    )
+
+bad_line_shape = [
+    index for index, _, after in changed
+    if line_shape(after["source"]) != line_shape(after["target"])
+]
+
+print(f"runtime={loader.runtime.luajit}")
+print(f"records_compared={len(current)}")
+print(f"changed_targets={len(changed)}")
+print(f"non_target_changes={len(non_target)}")
+print(f"unexpected_changed_targets={len(unexpected)}")
+print(f"missing_changed_targets={len(missing)}")
+print(f"line_invariants={len(changed) - len(bad_line_shape)}/{len(changed)}")
+
+if not (
+    len(changed) == 21
+    and not non_target
+    and not unexpected
+    and not missing
+    and not bad_line_shape
+):
+    raise SystemExit(1)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
